items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Neither could Billy Eckstine, he had to disband for the same reason. He preceded the Dizzy Gillespie band.

ctx.x: I think that’s factual. And so, he could try things. He, he could try to write music for the personalities that were in his band, and, and keep them working at the same time. So, but, like Dizzy’s big band was a unique band of the 40’s, but he couldn’t, financially, he couldn’t keep it together. Neither could Billy Eckstine, he had to disband for the same reason. He preceded the Dizzy Gillespie band. So, the means to let an idea grow and blossom, we all don’t have it. So, um some of our potentials are never…
What about um...the, the interaction with, with players in the band?
